Alert fires.

It is NOT proof.

Detection & Analysis closes that gap.
caption: Same discipline as triage from SOC Operations & SIEM Fundamentals, now applied at incident scale.

steps.label: Confirm
steps.sub: trace the activity against real evidence, not gut instinct

steps.label: Understand its nature
steps.sub: ransomware vs. a quiet compromised account vs. caught phishing

steps.label: Hand off
steps.sub: the right response depends on getting this call right

eyebrow: Both directions of error cost something
code:
Too quick to call it an incident:
  burns response capacity, erodes trust

Too slow or too skeptical to confirm it:
  attacker keeps operating -- dwell time grows
caption: Detection & Analysis exists to get this call right using evidence, before the team commits to a response.

subtitle: Stop the bleeding, remove the cause, return to normal.
